Hi Hannah / Monica,

Thanks for taking the time yesterday. We are ramping up CardinalPay's pilot and want to make sure the integration path is as low-friction as possible. High-level asks: SDK setup + quickstart, a migration plan for our existing endpoint to Redwood, recommended retries/timeouts/backoff, and guidance on rate-limit handling and token caching. Our timeline: pilot start 2027-09-20, production cutover targeted 2027-10-04.

Can you share a recommended mutual action plan and any sample code we can hand to our engineering team today? Also: are there any required network IP ranges or egress rules we should include in our security ticket?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Liu
Director, Integrations — CardinalPay

Date: 2027-09-01 12:03 PM -07:00
Subject: Re: App integration velocity handshake

Alex — thanks, we can definitely hit that pilot window. I attached a short starter bundle: redwood_sdk_samples_v1.zip (Node + Go snippets), a network diagram showing required egress to our regional endpoints, and a proposed mutual_action_plan.xlsx with a week-by-week breakdown.

Short answers up front:
- Network: allow outbound to *.redwood-api.com on ports 443 and 8443; we also include CIDR blocks in the attached diagram for private deployments.
- Migration approach: blue-green with mirrored staging traffic for 72 hours, then cutover to redirect traffic via DNS TTL=60s. We avoid in-place DB migrations; no downtime expected for read-only flows.
- Retries/timeouts: client-level request timeout 10s, server-suggested 30s for long streaming calls; use exponential backoff with jitter starting at 200ms up to 8s and max 5 attempts for idempotent requests.
- Rate limits: per-account token quota plus per-route QPS. We'll provide a pre-cutover quota lift for the pilot window if needed.

I'll loop Karthik for the SDK snippet that shows short-circuit retry logic and Monica for the implementation cadence. Proposed next step: 30-min technical sync Wednesday 2027-09-02 11:00 AM PT. Does that work?

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Manager, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
(Attachments: redwood_sdk_samples_v1.zip, network_diagram_cardinal.png, mutual_action_plan.xlsx)
